subject.title: Surface Codex final answer candidates in activity

question: Should answer-candidate lifecycle visibility land now as a narrow Activity surface, or be folded into the broader native Codex progress UX tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80039?
rationale: The code idea is coherent, but the visible Control UI surface and privacy/product boundary are tied to an open maintainer-reviewed UX issue, and the branch now needs a current-main port before merge.

options.title: Sponsor current-main port
options.body: Port this PR to ui/src/pages/activity and the current Codex projector, then review it as the answer-candidate slice of the broader progress work.

options.title: Fold into broader progress UX
options.body: Keep the idea but require a replacement implementation under the canonical native Codex progress issue rather than landing this narrow branch.

options.title: Pause separate surface
options.body: Do not add answer-candidate Activity entries until maintainers settle a single progress/status design for native Codex runs.

recommendation.title: Sponsor current-main port
recommendation.body: Port this PR to ui/src/pages/activity and the current Codex projector, then review it as the answer-candidate slice of the broader progress work.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the prior closed implementation and explicitly kept the native Codex visibility product need alive, so they have the clearest linked UX context in the available history.
